text:
maria: quick question — after flipping to flashattn-v3 for the new llama-like bring-up in eu-west, we're seeing p99 spikes for tiny payloads (batch=1, seq<=64). p50 looks fine. anyone seen this pattern?

sahil: saw something similar last month on a100. for tiny batches flashv3 has higher warmup cost and KV-cache churn sometimes. how big are the spikes?

maria: p50 8ms, p95 22ms, p99 120ms on h100-l40 with q8; before switchover (vendor cu-attn) p99 was ~40ms. link to scatter+time series: https://redwood-internal/charts/bench/1759876543 (chart shows repeated microbursts)

jing: are these during steady-state traffic or microbursts after idle?

maria: microbursts after short-idle periods — traffic pattern is PLG UI (lots of small prompts). also noticed higher variance in eu-west vs us-east for same kernel.

sahil: that points to NUMA/driver jitter + kernel init path. flashv3 does extra precomp/warmup on first requests per model variant. we’ve seen region-level scheduling differences cause more cold windows in eu-west.

maria: any quick mitigations? we can't revert globally; want per-route heuristic.

sahil: option 1 — route small/batch1 traffic to vendor-attn for now. option 2 — keep flashv3 but pin a small steady warmup loop per model instance to prevent cold windows. option 3 — use hybrid: flashv3 for long sequences, vendor-attn for short seqs.

jing: hybrid sounds best. we need cheap signal: payload_shape = (batch, seq) and recent-requests-since-warmup. Switch when seq<=64 and avg throughput < 20 r/s per instance.

maria: can we express that as routing rule in the runtime? e.g., if (batch*seq < 64 && p99_flashv3 > 2 * p99_vendor) then route -> vendor-attn

sahil: yes, runtime can accept a per-route kernel_preference function. but avoid metric comparisons in the fast-path. better: static rule by payload shape + a flag for 'hot' instances.

ops-bot: canary-deploy of "hybrid-shortseq-routing" started in eu-west-1 at 2025-01-14T11:30Z :rocket:

maria: test plan I ran (if helpful):
```
# bench command
run_bench --model redwood-llama-v2 --kernel flashv3 --quant q8 --batch 1 --seq 32 --duration 300 --rps 5
run_bench --model redwood-llama-v2 --kernel vendor-attn --quant q8 --batch 1 --seq 32 --duration 300 --rps 5
```
compare p50/p95/p99 and tail histograms. also run across h100/a100 and eu/us regions.

jing: note: quantization interacts — q4/q8 kernel codepaths differ and flashv3's q8 path does more memory ops. include q4 runs.

sahil: after canary, if hybrid reduces tail by >30% for small payloads in eu-west, promote. else iterate on warmup thread.

maria: capturing action items: 1) enable hybrid short-seq routing in eu-west canary (ops) 2) run bench matrix (maria/jing) across h100/a100, q4/q8, seq 16/32/64 3) collect per-instance warmup counters and p99 (sahil)

ops-bot: created ticket ML-1304 "hybrid-attn-routing + warmup probes" assigned to eng-ml with priority P2

maria: thanks — will post results in this thread in ~2 hours :thumbsup:
